name: Dalim Tweedle
source:
Evil Prince & Ladies Man

As the owner of the bar Oasis, he flirts with all of his women costumers. However, his true identity is revealed to be a powerful Magic Disciple... 
Even though his appearance is identical to Dean, he denies that they are twin brothers. 

"I just can't let you go... Sorry, but this is the way I show my affection for you."

[From in-game profile]
